entries.restriction: ABI-compatible local backport of gtk-rs/gtk-rs-core#1343; checked by scripts/check-vendor-patches.cjs. Remove when Tauri adopts glib >=0.20.

reviewNotes: Rechecked RUSTSEC-2024-0429 against gtk-rs/gtk-rs-core#1343 (05dff0ee696f9bcd8617cd48c4b812d046d440cb): the selected glib 0.18.5 backport uses a mutable C out-pointer. Tauri 2.11.5 still requires GTK3/glib 0.18. The optimized five-method iterator regression passed on Linux x64 and ARM64 for master e8de427. Updated rustix to 1.1.6 (RUSTSEC-2026-0486), tokio to 1.53.3 (RUSTSEC-2026-0386), and replaced yanked async-executor 1.14.0 with 1.14.1. No new exceptions. The zbus_names/zvariant/zvariant_derive maintenance advisories remain visible; replacing their Tauri-owned zbus 5 dependency requires an upstream migration. See src-tauri/vendor/README.md for review evidence and limits.
